record.paper_title: Research Problems on Relations Between Nijenhuis Geometry and Integrable Systems
record.context_brief: Existence of special operator fields in F-manifolds
record.original_question: In the known examples of F-manifolds arising in this framework, does there always exist a nonconstant gl-regular operator field L satisfying Lie_e L = 0, as assumed in Proposition 3.2?

evidence.quote: (1) Proposition 3.2 uses the existence of an operator field L with LeL = 0. Is it true that in all known examples, such an operator field exists? It is, of course, non-constant but still.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth (or analytic) manifold equipped with a $(1,1)$-tensor field $L$ (an operator field). Recall:

(i) $L$ is called a Nijenhuis operator if its Nijenhuis torsion vanishes, i.e.
$$\mathcal{N}_L(X,Y) := L^2[X,Y] - L[LX,Y] - L[X,LY] + [LX,LY] = 0 \quad \text{for all vector fields } X,Y.$$

(ii) $L$ is called gl-regular at a point $p\in M$ if its minimal polynomial at $p$ coincides with its characteristic polynomial; equivalently, $L_p$ admits a cyclic vector. $L$ is gl-regular on $M$ if it is gl-regular at every point.

(iii) An F-manifold structure on $M$ consists of a commutative associative fiberwise multiplication $\circ$ on $TM$ with unit vector field $e$ such that the Hertling–Manin condition
$$\mathcal{C}_{X\circ Y}(Z,W) = X\circ \mathcal{C}_Y(Z,W) + Y\circ \mathcal{C}_X(Z,W)$$
holds, where $\mathcal{C}_X(Z,W) := [X, Z\circ W] - [X,Z]\circ W - Z\circ[X,W] - X\circ[Z,W]$.

A standard construction associates to a Nijenhuis operator $L$ with a chosen unity vector field $e$ (satisfying suitable compatibility) the F-manifold structure with product $X\circ Y$ determined by $L$ and $e$, in such a way that $L$ becomes the operator of multiplication by a distinguished vector field.

Question. Suppose $(M,\circ,e)$ is an F-manifold that arises in the above Nijenhuis-geometric framework (i.e., one of the F-manifolds currently known to come from this construction). Does there always exist a nonconstant gl-regular operator field $L$ on $M$ satisfying
$$\mathcal{L}_e L = 0,$$
where $\mathcal{L}_e$ denotes the Lie derivative along the unity vector field $e$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open research problem in the Nijenhuis-geometry/F-manifolds program (Bolsinov, Konyaev, Antonov and collaborators). Related results establish a correspondence between regular F-manifolds and Nijenhuis manifolds with a cyclic unity, and provide local normal forms for gl-regular Nijenhuis operators with a unity, but I found no source that resolves the specific question of whether a nonconstant gl-regular L with Lie_e L = 0 exists in all known examples.

status_evidence.title: Nijenhuis operators with a unity and F-manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes that regular F-manifolds coincide with Nijenhuis manifolds with a cyclic unity.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the framework relating F-manifolds and Nijenhuis operators with a unity, but does not settle the existence question for nonconstant gl-regular L with Lie_e L=0 in all known examples.

status_evidence.title: Nijenhuis Geometry III: gl-regular Nijenhuis operators
status_evidence.snippet: Local normal forms for gl-regular Nijenhuis operators at algebraically generic points.
status_evidence.claim: Treats gl-regular Nijenhuis operators but leaves the global existence question open.
